windowsClaudeWarning.title: Claude Code Installation Required
windowsClaudeWarning.message: To use Nimbalyst's AI features on Windows, you need to install Claude Code separately. Without it, many agentic editing features will not be available.

workspaceManager.welcomeDescription: Projects are local folders on your computer. Open any folder to view and edit all markdown files within it. If you are working on a coding project, it is recommended to open the root folder of your project as agents are configured at the project level.
workspaceManager.renameWarningTitle: This will rename the project folder on disk
workspaceManager.renameWarningMessage: All AI session history, file history, and settings will be migrated. This may take a while for large projects.
workspaceManager.moveWarningTitle: This will move the entire project folder
workspaceManager.moveWarningMessage: All project files will be copied to the new location, and all AI session history, file history, and settings will be migrated. This may take a while for large projects.

session.selectOrCreateSession: Select a session or create a new one to get started
session.enterTaskBelow: Enter a task below to get started
session.askQuestionPlaceholder: Ask a question. @ for files, @@ for sessions, / for commands
session.typeMessagePlaceholder: Type your message... (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line, @ for files, @@ for sessions, / for commands)
session.chooseAIModelDescription: Choose which AI model to use. Different models have different capabilities and speeds.
session.filterFileTreeDescription: Show only markdown files, uncommitted git changes, or files the AI has read or written in this session.

settings.agentProvidersTooltip:
Agents run in loops against your files to produce work. 

They have full MCP support with file system access, multi-file operations, and session persistence.

Best for complex coding tasks.
settings.chatProvidersTooltip:
Chat mode is a quicker, more focused tool that is limited to reading and writing your currently open file.

Uses direct API calls with files attached as context. Faster responses, simpler behavior. Includes local model support via LM Studio.

Best for quick edits and tasks that do not require multi-file operations.

projectAI.title: AI Providers
projectAI.description: Override AI provider settings for {workspaceName}. Enable overrides to use different API keys or models.
projectAI.apiKeyHintGlobal: Leave empty to use global key, or enter a project-specific key
projectAI.apiKeyHintNoGlobal: Enter an API key for this project
projectAI.noOverrideMessage: This project uses global settings for {provider}.
projectAI.noOverrideHint: Enable override to customize API key or models for this project.
projectAI.resetOverridesConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all project overrides? This will revert to using global settings.
projectAI.hasOverrides: This project has custom AI provider settings
projectAI.trackerAutomationDesc: Override the global tracker automation setting for this workspace.

agentFeatures.title: Agent Features
agentFeatures.description: Settings that control how agent sessions behave.
agentFeatures.autoApproveCommitsDesc: Automatically approve when Claude proposes git commits.
agentFeatures.preferredLanguageHint: Preferred language for AI-generated session names (e.g. "Japanese", "ja", "Spanish"). Leave blank to let the agent pick based on the conversation.
agentFeatures.experimentalWarning: These features may change, regress, or be removed. Some require a restart to take full effect.
agentFeatures.skillsAndCommandsDescription: Control which command and skill sources feed the shared picker and which generated compatibility exports are written for Claude Code and Codex.
agentFeatures.workspaceClaudeCompatibilityDesc: Import project and user .claude commands and skills into the shared workflow registry.
agentFeatures.projectClaudeSourcesDesc: Include .claude/commands and .claude/skills from the current workspace.
agentFeatures.userClaudeSourcesDesc: Include ~/.claude commands and skills when you want user-level compatibility in the picker and exports.
agentFeatures.extensionWorkflowsDesc: Load provider-neutral agentWorkflows contributions and legacy Claude plugin workflows from enabled extensions.
agentFeatures.codexGeneratedSkillsDesc: Export registry workflows into .agents/skills/.nimbalyst-generated before Codex turns.
agentFeatures.claudeGeneratedExtensionWorkflowsDesc: Generate Claude plugin shims for extension agentWorkflows under .claude/plugins/.nimbalyst-generated.
agentFeatures.showToolCallsInChatDesc: Display tool call rows in the AI chat view. Turn off to hide tool activity and see only the conversational messages.
agentFeatures.showAllToolCallsDesc: Display all MCP tool calls in the AI chat sidebar, including Edit/applyDiff calls.
agentFeatures.aiDebugLoggingDesc: Capture detailed logs of all AI editing operations including LLM requests/responses.
agentFeatures.showPromptAdditionsDesc: Display system prompt additions and context that Nimbalyst appends to Claude Code requests.

voiceMode.title: Voice Mode
voiceMode.description: Use OpenAI's Advanced Voice Mode to control Claude Code with your voice. Speak naturally to give commands, and receive spoken responses.
voiceMode.openaiApiKeyDesc: Required for Voice Mode. Get one from platform.openai.com.
voiceMode.showVoiceModeButtonDesc: Display the microphone button in the AI input area
voiceMode.micDeniedDesc: Voice Mode needs microphone access. Enable it for Nimbalyst in System Settings, then re-check below.
voiceMode.micRestrictedDesc: Microphone access is restricted on this device (e.g. by parental controls or MDM). Voice Mode cannot capture audio.
voiceMode.micDefaultDesc: Voice Mode needs microphone access. Open System Settings to grant it for Nimbalyst.
voiceMode.voiceDesc: Choose the voice for the assistant. Each voice has its own personality and tone.
voiceMode.previewHint: Preview plays a short sample using OpenAI's TTS API.
voiceMode.realtimeOnlyHint: This voice is Realtime-only; preview uses a similar voice.
voiceMode.allowInterruptionsDesc: You can interrupt the assistant while it's speaking by starting to talk
voiceMode.listenWindowDurationDesc: How long to keep listening after you stop speaking. After this time, the mic goes to sleep until the assistant responds or you click the mic button.
voiceMode.reviewDelayDesc: Time to review and edit voice commands before they're sent to the coding agent. Set to 0 for immediate submission.
voiceMode.projectSummaryDesc: The voice assistant uses an AI-generated summary of your project to understand context.
voiceMode.generateSummaryHint: Launches an agent session that reads your project and writes the summary file. You'll be taken to the session so you can watch it work.
voiceMode.configureInSettings: Configure one in AI Models settings
voiceMode.usageDesc: OpenAI charges for voice mode usage:
voiceMode.plusTokenCosts: Plus standard token costs for processing
voiceMode.howItWorksDesc: Voice Mode uses OpenAI's Advanced Voice Mode (GPT Realtime) as an intelligent voice interface to Claude Code. You speak your coding requests naturally, and the voice assistant translates them into Claude Code commands.
voiceMode.howItWorksDesc2: When Claude Code finishes working, the assistant summarizes what was done and speaks it back to you.
voiceMode.systemPromptDesc: Customize the behavior of the voice agent and coding agent during voice mode sessions.
voiceMode.voiceAgentDesc: Customize the voice assistant (GPT-4 Realtime) that handles speech interaction.
voiceMode.prependDesc: Added before the default voice assistant instructions
voiceMode.appendDesc: Added after the default voice assistant instructions
voiceMode.codingAgentDesc: Customize the coding agent (Claude) when processing voice mode requests. These instructions are added to the system prompt only during voice mode sessions.
voiceMode.prependCodingDesc: Added before the coding agent's voice mode context
voiceMode.appendCodingDesc: Added after the coding agent's voice mode context
voiceMode.generateSummaryConfirmMessage: This will launch a new AI session using {model}. The session will read your project files and write a voice-friendly summary to {path}, which voice mode uses for context. You'll be taken to the session so you can watch it run.

projectPermissions.description: Manage which commands the AI agent can run in this project. Approved patterns are saved to
projectPermissions.openWorkspace: Open a workspace to configure agent permissions.
projectPermissions.trustedDesc: The AI agent can run commands in this workspace.
projectPermissions.notTrustedDesc: Trust this workspace to allow the AI agent to run commands.
projectPermissions.askModeDesc: Agent asks before running commands. Approvals saved to .claude/settings.local.json.
projectPermissions.allowEditsModeDesc: File operations auto-approved. Bash and web requests follow Claude Code settings.
projectPermissions.allowAllModeDesc: All operations auto-approved without any prompts.
projectPermissions.additionalDirectoriesDesc: Allow the agent to access directories outside this project.
projectPermissions.noAdditionalDirs: No additional directories. The agent can only access files within this project.
projectPermissions.urlPatternsDesc: URL patterns the agent is allowed to access.
projectPermissions.noUrlPatterns: No URL patterns. The agent cannot access external URLs.

providerOverride.enableOverrideHint: Enable override to customize {providerName} settings for this project only. Changes will not affect your global settings.

filesScope.uncommittedSessionEditsDesc: Files edited by AI with uncommitted changes

feedback.useAgentDescription: Use your Agent to improve your bug reports and feature requests. Your agent will help draft it, and you approve everything before GitHub opens.
feedback.bugReportDesc: Broken behavior, crashes, sync issues, or regressions.
feedback.featureRequestDesc: Missing capabilities, workflow improvements, or UX changes.
feedback.includeLogsDesc: Logs may include file paths, workspace names, and error details. The assistant anonymizes them first, and you review the final report before it is posted.
feedback.exploreWithMockup: Explore the idea with a UX mockup first
feedback.exploreWithMockupDesc: Best for interface or workflow changes. The assistant can sketch a mockup, refine it with you, and include that visual direction in the request.

sharedLinks.createLinkHint: Right-click a file or session and select "Share link" to create one.

installedExtensions.title: Installed Extensions
installedExtensions.noExtensionsDesc: Extensions are installed in the extensions folder. Check the documentation for instructions on how to install extensions.
installedExtensions.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall this extension? This will remove its files and settings.

marketplace.title: Extension Marketplace
marketplace.description: Discover and install extensions to enhance your Nimbalyst workspace.
marketplace.securityWarningDesc1: Extensions run with access to your local file system and can execute code on your machine. Installing untrusted extensions may pose security risks including:
marketplace.riskReadFiles: Reading or modifying files on your computer
marketplace.riskExecuteCode: Executing arbitrary code in the application context
marketplace.securityWarningDesc2: Only install extensions from sources you trust. Nimbalyst does not review or verify third-party extensions installed from GitHub URLs. Marketplace extensions published by Nimbalyst are reviewed for safety.
marketplace.resetInSettings: You can reset this in Settings > Advanced
marketplace.extensionNotFound: Extension {id} was not found in the marketplace
marketplace.reviewBeforeInstall: Review {name} before installing it from the marketplace
marketplace.githubInstallHint: Paste a GitHub repository URL containing a Nimbalyst extension (must have manifest.json).

extensionConfig.noConfigurableSettings: This extension has no configurable settings.

team.projectIdentityDesc: Teams are linked to a git remote, so any member who opens a clone of the same repo is automatically connected.
team.removeMemberConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this member from the team?
team.deleteTeamConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete team "{name}"? This action cannot be undone. All shared data will be deleted.
team.reShareKeyHint: Re-share the encryption key with this member (e.g., after they changed devices)
team.fingerprintChangedWarning: This member's identity key has changed since you last verified it. Verify their new fingerprint before trusting data from them.
team.compareFingerprint: Compare this fingerprint with {name} out-of-band (e.g., in person or via a secure channel) to verify their identity.
team.encryptionDesc: Team data is encrypted with keys shared via ECDH key exchange. The server never sees your data.
team.encryptionFeature1: Encryption keys are shared directly between team members
team.encryptionFeature2: Only verified team members can decrypt shared data
team.encryptionFeature3: Removing a member rotates the encryption key
team.pricingNotice: Nimbalyst Teams is free during alpha. We plan to introduce a paid subscription tier for teams in the future; existing teams will get advance notice before any pricing change.
team.thisProjectIsPersonal: This project is personal. Create a team to share tracker items, documents, and collaborate in real time.
team.noTeamDesc: This project is personal. Create a team to share tracker items, documents, and collaborate in real time.
team.shareFingerprint: Share this fingerprint with your team members so they can verify your identity.
team.inviteMessage: You have been invited to join this team. Accept to collaborate on shared tracker items and documents with end-to-end encryption.

claudeCodePanel.agentTeamsDesc: Allow Claude to coordinate multiple agents working together as a team. Uses more tokens but enables parallel work.
